Name: Random British Cop
Text: Oi! You're trespassing.

Name: Random British Cop
Text: This area leads to a restricted forest zone—civilians aren’t allowed past here.

choices.text: I have clearance to be here.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: Who are you?

Name: Random British Cop
Text: Name’s John. I’m with the British police.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: Never seen anyone posted here before. You stationed alone?

Name: John
Text: ...That's none of your business.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: I'm with the Office of Environmental Affairs. I’ve been assigned to investigate illegal deforestation in this region.

Name: John
Text: Right. And you're here without backup or notice?

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: The situation’s urgent. We got a tip this area was cleared overnight.

Name: John
Text: Well, whoever sent that tip wants you dead. This forest... it’s not what it seems.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: What do you mean by that?

Name: John
Text: ...Just turn around and leave. Come back with proper clearance. Or better yet, don’t come back at all.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: Are you hiding something, Officer John?

Name: John
Text: I’m trying to keep you alive. That forest took good men. It doesn’t care who you are.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: If there’s a threat, I need to report it. Let me pass.

Name: John
Text: ...Suit yourself. But don’t say I didn’t warn you.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: I have clearance to be here.

Name: John
Text: You do? Then let’s see the papers.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: ...They were lost during transit. But I'm not here to start trouble.

Name: John
Text: Lost or never existed?

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: I just need to verify a report of illegal activity.

Name: John
Text: Listen. This forest has its own rules. You walk in without knowing them, you don’t walk out.

Name: Ethan (Main Character)
Text: So you're confirming something's going on here?

Name: John
Text: I'm confirming you'll die if you don't turn back.
